newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CCA, San Miguel to combine operations.
newsitem.headline: CCA, San Miguel to combine operations.

text.p: Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd said on Thursday San Miguel Corp of the Philippines had agreed in principle to combine its soft drink operations with those of Coca Cola Amatil.

Coca-Cola Amatil said a San Miguel subsidiary, Coca Cola Bottlers Philippines Inc (CCBPI), would combine with Coca-Cola Amatil to create the largest Coca-Cola bottling group outside the United States.
CCBPI owns and operates 21 soft drinks plants in the Philippines and is owned 70 percent by San Miguel and 30 percent by The Coca-Cola Company.
Coca-Cola Amatil said CCBPI has a 75 percent share of the Philippines market and generated a net profit in 1996 of A$144 million.
